sentences.en: You'll have this composition written by noon tomorrow, won't you?
sentences.zh: 你明天中午之前能把这篇作文写完吗？

sentences.en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
sentences.zh: 你的作文很好，几乎没有错误。

sentences.en: What a big mistake you made in your English composition!
sentences.zh: 你在英语作文里犯了一个大错！

senses.zh: 创作，写作，作曲 - 作文，作品 - 构图；构成，成分 - 混合物，合成物
